gp.setting.name: Strategic megaprojects & consortia
gp.setting.desc: Enable multi-stage regional megaprojects, allied consortium co-funding, conquest inheritance, supply chokepoints and covert sabotage.

gp.opinion.consortium_completed: Completed a joint megaproject consortium with us
gp.opinion.chokepoint_weaponized: Weaponized a strategic supply chokepoint against us
gp.opinion.strategic_supply_anchor: Anchored our strategic commodity supply reliably

gp.proj.transcontinental_hsr.name: Transcontinental High-Speed Rail Corridor
gp.proj.transcontinental_hsr.desc: An electrified freight-and-passenger spine linking industrial heartlands to frontier depots, lifting trade reach, supply throughput and regional construction pace.
gp.proj.sovereign_fusion_grid.name: Sovereign Fusion & HVDC Energy Grid
gp.proj.sovereign_fusion_grid.desc: Baseload next-generation reactors coupled to ultra-high-voltage transmission corridors, lowering energy bottlenecks and elevating industrial output and living standards.
gp.proj.geothermal_baseload_ring.name: Deep Geothermal & Hydrogen Industrial Ring
gp.proj.geothermal_baseload_ring.desc: Closed-loop deep geothermal wells paired with industrial green-hydrogen feeders, cutting construction costs and raising resilient domestic output.
gp.proj.deepwater_megaport.name: Deep-Water Transshipment Megaport
gp.proj.deepwater_megaport.desc: Automated deep-draft berths, drydocks and container railheads expanding maritime trade reach, hull laydown rates and strategic fleet mobility.
gp.proj.arctic_icebreaker_corridor.name: Polar Sea Route & Icebreaker Corridor
gp.proj.arctic_icebreaker_corridor.desc: Nuclear-capable icebreaker bases, polar radar stations and high-latitude bunkering hubs opening an alternate intercontinental sea lane.
gp.proj.sovereign_semiconductor_fab.name: Sovereign Semiconductor Foundry Complex
gp.proj.sovereign_semiconductor_fab.desc: Cleanroom lithography fabs and advanced packaging lines anchoring domestic electronics supply, accelerating research and restoring precision long-range forces.
gp.proj.subsea_cable_nexus.name: Subsea Fiber & Signals Nexus
gp.proj.subsea_cable_nexus.desc: Armored transoceanic landing stations, low-latency financial routing exchanges and sovereign data vaults boosting research, trade reach and credit capacity.
gp.proj.orbital_launch_complex.name: Sovereign Orbital Launch Complex
gp.proj.orbital_launch_complex.desc: Heavy-lift launch pads, telemetry arrays and satellite integration hangars expanding national science, strategic deterrence and aerospace survivability.
gp.proj.strategic_aerospace_arsenal.name: Joint Aerospace & Drone Arsenal
gp.proj.strategic_aerospace_arsenal.desc: Modular composite airframe lines, automated avionics bays and drone swarming depots accelerating support-wing recovery and cutting attrition over defended skies.
gp.proj.continental_defense_shield.name: Integrated Continental Defense Shield
gp.proj.continental_defense_shield.desc: Hardened radar grids, command bunkers and fortified logistics lines multiplying defensive firepower, entrenchment speed and strategic deterrence.
gp.proj.international_science_citadel.de: A singular global campus of national laboratories, supercomputing halls and graduate institutes driving breakthrough research and civic confidence.
gp.proj.global_diplomatic_forum.name: World Diplomatic Forum & Arbitration Hall
gp.proj.global_diplomatic_forum.desc: A singular permanent international arbitration assembly and treaty registry reinforcing national stability, sovereign credit standing and civil calm.
gp.proj.sovereign_reserve_vault.name: Sovereign Bullion & Clearing House
gp.proj.sovereign_reserve_vault.desc: A fortified monetary clearing center and sovereign reserve depository widening borrowing capacity, trimming risk premiums and sharpening tax collection.
gp.proj.continental_grain_belt.name: Automated Agro-Industrial & Desalination Belt
gp.proj.continental_grain_belt.desc: Precision-irrigated breadbasket zones, coastal desalination plants and automated grain silos lifting living standards, stability and baseline output.
gp.proj.transoceanic_canal_tunnel.name: Strategic Strait Tunnel & Freight Corridor
gp.proj.transoceanic_canal_tunnel.desc: Twin-bore rail and highway crossings bypassing maritime chokepoints, accelerating army strategic mobility, trade reach and front-line supply.
gp.proj.metropolitan_renewal_plan.name: National Post-War Metropolitan Renewal
gp.proj.metropolitan_renewal_plan.desc: Coordinated housing, grid and civic reconstruction in war-damaged or impoverished regions, speeding repair while restoring stability and cutting radicalism.

gp.mod.supply_diversification_pact.name: Supply Diversification Compact
gp.mod.supply_diversification_pact.desc: State-backed alternative import corridors widen trade reach and steady output at a modest sovereign borrowing premium.
gp.mod.export_control_regime.name: Sovereign Export-Control Regime
gp.mod.export_control_regime.desc: Directed domestic R&D and industrial priorities accelerate science and building while narrowing external trade reach.
gp.mod.convoy_escort_charter.name: Maritime Convoy Escort Charter
gp.mod.convoy_escort_charter.desc: Armed naval escorts and protected merchant routing accelerate fleet transit, logistics supply and maritime trade reach.
gp.mod.fast_track_overdrive.name: Megaproject Fast-Track Overdrive
gp.mod.fast_track_overdrive.desc: Emergency permitting and round-the-clock shifts speed national construction at higher project cost and labor friction.
gp.mod.creditor_austerity_covenant.name: Creditor Debt-Swap Covenant
gp.mod.creditor_austerity_covenant.desc: Binding fiscal targets expand credit capacity, cut borrowing costs and sharpen tax collection at the price of tighter household living standards.
gp.mod.joint_deterrence_posture.name: Strategic Deterrence Posture
gp.mod.joint_deterrence_posture.desc: Combined-arms readiness drills bolster strategic deterrence, entrenchment pace and division organisation recovery.
gp.mod.freight_reroute.name: Maritime Freight Rerouting
gp.mod.freight_reroute.desc: Longer shipping detours around contested chokepoints depress trade reach and raise construction costs.
gp.mod.lithography_crash.name: Sovereign Lithography Crash Program
gp.mod.lithography_crash.desc: Emergency state backing for domestic tooling boosts research pace at a higher sovereign risk premium.
gp.mod.transit_boom.name: Energy Transit Windfall
gp.mod.transit_boom.desc: Pipeline and LNG hub transit fees widen trade reach and bolster fiscal tax efficiency.
gp.mod.engineering_breakthrough.name: Flagship Engineering Breakthrough
gp.mod.engineering_breakthrough.desc: Modular fabrication techniques discovered on national works accelerate construction and research nationwide.
gp.dec.supply_div.name: Strategic supply diversification drive
gp.dec.supply_div.desc: Underwrite alternative port, rail and commodity suppliers to break single-country chokepoint leverage. Raises market access and trade reach for a year at a modest financing premium.
gp.dec.supply_div.unavail: Requires a solvent treasury to underwrite alternative supply corridors.
gp.dec.export_ctrl.name: Enact sovereign export controls
gp.dec.export_ctrl.desc: Restrict strategic technology exports and redirect engineering talent into domestic champions. Accelerates research and construction, but narrows foreign trade reach and raises notoriety.
gp.dec.export_ctrl.unavail: Requires at least 55% national literacy to sustain sovereign tech controls.
gp.dec.convoy.name: Charter maritime convoy escorts
gp.dec.convoy.desc: Assign naval task forces to escort commercial shipping through contested straits, restoring market access, supply throughput and fleet speed.
gp.dec.convoy.unavail: Requires at least one active fleet hull to run convoy escorts.
gp.dec.fast_track.name: Megaproject fast-track authority
gp.dec.fast_track.desc: Override local permitting delays and run three-shift construction across flagship works. Delivers a sharp construction surge at higher costs, stability strain and labor friction.
gp.dec.fast_track.unavail: Requires a solvent treasury and at least 45% stability.
gp.dec.debt_swap.name: Negotiate sovereign debt-swap accord
gp.dec.debt_swap.desc: Cut 8% of public debt principal immediately and restore creditor confidence by accepting a binding one-year fiscal covenant that squeezes living standards and stability.
gp.dec.debt_swap.unavail: Available only when sovereign debt reaches at least $20B.
gp.dec.deterrence.name: Conduct joint strategic deterrence drills
gp.dec.deterrence.desc: Spend army and air experience on synchronized theater readiness exercises, lifting strategic deterrence, organisation recovery and war support while alarming rivals.
gp.dec.deterrence.unavail: Requires a solvent treasury and combined service experience.
gp.ev.swf.title: Sovereign Wealth Fund Rebalancing Crisis
gp.ev.swf.desc: Persistent inflation and volatile bond yields have exposed our sovereign reserve portfolio. Finance ministers demand an immediate mandate on how to defend currency stability.
gp.ev.swf.opt1: Deploy reserves to defend price stability
gp.ev.swf.con1: Spends treasury; cools inflation sharply and lifts credit confidence and stability.
gp.ev.swf.opt2: Liquidate foreign assets into the budget
gp.ev.swf.con2: Refills treasury today, but stokes inflation and domestic radicalism.
gp.ev.swf.opt3: Retire sovereign debt ahead of schedule
gp.ev.swf.con3: Trims public debt and boosts credit confidence at a slight growth cost.
gp.ev.chokepoint.title: Maritime Chokepoint Freight Insurance Spike
gp.ev.chokepoint.desc: Tension along key sea lanes has tripled maritime war-risk premiums, stalling bulk imports and threatening industrial schedules.
gp.ev.chokepoint.con1: Costs treasury; restores market access and builds naval escort experience.
gp.ev.chokepoint.con2: Preserves cash, but depresses trade reach and raises inflation and build costs for 6 months.
gp.ev.sanctions.title: Technology Export Sanctions Backfire
gp.ev.sanctions.desc: Foreign restrictions on precision components have disrupted domestic high-tech supply chains while opening space for domestic import substitution.
gp.ev.sanctions.opt1: Launch a sovereign lithography crash program
gp.ev.sanctions.con1: Heavy treasury outlay; boosts productivity and research speed at a higher borrowing cost.
gp.ev.sanctions.con2: Spends political credit; restores market access and cools international notoriety.
gp.ev.sanctions.con3: Rallies domestic war support, but raises notoriety and cuts market access.
gp.ev.energy.title: Energy Corridor Transit Windfall
gp.ev.energy.desc: Shifting global trade flows have routed record pipeline and LNG volumes through our terminals, filling state accounts.
gp.ev.energy.opt1: Channel transit royalties into strategic works
gp.ev.energy.con1: Boosts treasury, construction capacity, tax efficiency and trade reach.
gp.ev.energy.con2: Raises regional living standards and stability while cutting radicalism.
gp.ev.armsrace.title: Regional Arms Race Escalation
gp.ev.armsrace.desc: High defense budgets along our borders have triggered reciprocal force buildups among neighboring capitals. The cabinet must choose posture over restraint.
gp.ev.armsrace.con1: Costs treasury and raises notoriety; earns army and air experience.
gp.ev.armsrace.con2: Lowers notoriety and earns political credit, but softens war support.
gp.ev.summit.title: Opportunity to Host a Neutral Peace Summit
gp.ev.summit.desc: Warring capitals and regional powers have sounded out our foreign ministry to host high-level mediation talks on neutral ground.
gp.ev.summit.con1: Modest treasury cost; yields major political credit, lower notoriety and stronger credit confidence.
gp.ev.summit.con2: No upfront cost; modest stability and market access gains.
gp.ev.breakthrough.title: Flagship Engineering Breakthrough
gp.ev.breakthrough.desc: Lead civil engineers have perfected a modular prefabrication method capable of cutting months off major national infrastructure schedules.
gp.ev.breakthrough.opt1: Standardize the method across state ministries
gp.ev.breakthrough.con1: Costs treasury; grants a major construction speed and research boost for 8 months.
gp.ev.breakthrough.con2: Earns treasury royalties, GDP lift and political credit.
gp.ev.strike.title: Megaproject Contractor Strike & Safety Audit
gp.ev.strike.desc: Rising living costs and grueling overtime on flagship construction sites have sparked coordinated walkouts across major contracting syndicates.
gp.ev.strike.opt1: Grant wage indexing and independent safety inspectors
gp.ev.strike.con1: Costs treasury; restores stability and lowers regional radicalism.
gp.ev.strike.con2: Forces higher construction capacity, but damages stability and spikes radicalism.
gp.ev.cartel.title: Critical Minerals Cartel Squeeze
gp.ev.cartel.desc: Dominant exporters of rare earths and battery feedstocks have coordinated production quotas, driving spot shortages across high-tech industries.
gp.ev.cartel.opt1: Subsidize domestic recycling and processing plants
gp.ev.cartel.con1: Costs treasury; raises productivity and recovers market access.
gp.ev.cartel.con2: Saves cash and builds political credit at a modest GDP cost.
gp.ev.aishift.title: Sovereign AI & Industrial Automation Shock
gp.ev.aishift.desc: Rapid deployment of autonomous logistics and sovereign AI models is surging industrial productivity while displacing clerical and factory workforces.
gp.ev.aishift.opt1: Fund a national workforce retraining compact
gp.ev.aishift.con1: Costs treasury; locks in high productivity, higher literacy and lower radicalism.
gp.ev.aishift.con2: Free GDP and productivity surge, but increases radicalism and strains stability.
gp.ev.aishift.con3: Protects near-term stability, but slows productivity and nudges brain drain upward.
